concerns.text: The plan uses the surrogate target `activation_barrier` as both a predictor (included in the linear baseline and potentially in the XGBoost feature set) and the response variable. This creates a circular/tautological validation: the model can trivially learn the identity mapping, inflating performance metrics (Pearson R, MAE) and rendering the significance test between XGBoost and baseline meaningless. The research question—whether expanded descriptors improve prediction of catalytic activity—cannot be answered because the target is directly fed to the model.
